intro_en: Learn how a breeding-program officer raises a guardian puppy to bond with the flock. You'll use the Mongolian comitative-reflexive ending -тайгаа/-тэйгээ/-тойгоо, as in сүрэгтэйгээ (with its flock). You'll also compare the English patterns 'no sooner had... than' and 'as soon as'.
intro_mn: Үржүүлгийн хөтөлбөрийн ажилтан хамгаалагч гөлгийг сүрэгт хэрхэн дасгадаг тухай ярина. Та -тайгаа/-тэйгээ/-тойгоо нөхцөл (сүрэгтэйгээ, эзэнтэйгээ) болон англи хэлний 'no sooner had... than', 'as soon as' хэллэгийг судална.

vocab.example_mn: Гөлөг найман долоо хоногтойдоо малчны гэрт ирсэн.
vocab.example_en: The puppy came to the herder's home at eight weeks old.

vocab.en: to raise together with lambs and kids
vocab.example_mn: Гөлгийг хурга ишигтэй хамт өсгөвөл сүргээ гэр бүлээ гэж үздэг.
vocab.example_en: If a puppy is raised with lambs and kids, it sees the flock as its family.

vocab.en: to accustom, to get (someone) used to
vocab.example_mn: Гөлгийг багаас нь малд дасгах хэрэгтэй.
vocab.example_en: You need to get a puppy used to livestock from an early age.
The dog went out to pasture with its flock.
Bankhar are born with a protective instinct.

vocab.example_mn: Үржүүлгийн хөтөлбөр малчдад гөлөг үнэгүй олгодог.
vocab.example_en: The breeding program gives herders puppies for free.
The kid ran after its mother.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр нохойгоо дуудахад ирдэг болгож сургасан.
vocab.example_en: He trained his dog to come when called.

sentences.mn: Гөлөг хашаанд орж ирмэгц хурга ишигтэй танилцаж эхэлсэн.
sentences.en: As soon as the puppy came into the pen, it started getting to know the lambs and kids.
alt_en: No sooner had the puppy come into the pen than it started getting to know the lambs and kids.
sentences.mn_latin: Gölög khashaand orj irmegts khurga ishigtei taniltsaj ekhelsen.

sentences.en: Our puppy sleeps with its flock.
alt_en: Our puppy sleeps together with its flock.

sentences.en: The dog went to the pasture with its owner.
alt_en: The dog went out to pasture with its owner.

sentences.mn: Гөлгийг эхний гурван сард нь хурга ишигтэй хамт өсгөх нь хамгийн чухал.
sentences.en: Raising the puppy with lambs and kids in its first three months is the most important thing.
alt_en: The most important thing is to raise the puppy with lambs and kids during its first three months.
sentences.mn_latin: Gölgiig ekhnii gurvan sard ni khurga ishigtei khamt ösgökh ni khamgiin chukhal.

sentences.mn: Итгэл нэг өдрийн дотор бий болдоггүй.
sentences.en: Trust doesn't develop in a single day.
sentences.mn_latin: Itgel neg ödriin dotor bii boldoggüi.

sentences.mn: Чоно ойртож ирмэгц банхар сүргийнхээ өмнө гарч зогсов.
sentences.en: No sooner had the wolf come near than the bankhar stepped in front of its flock.
alt_en: As soon as the wolf came near, the bankhar stepped in front of its flock.
sentences.mn_latin: Chono oirtoj irmegts bankhar sürgiinkhee ömnö garch zogsov.

sentences.en: Bat introduced the puppy to his children.
alt_en: Bat introduced his puppy to his kids.

sentences.mn: Гөлгийг хүнд хэт их дасгавал сүргээ орхиж, гэр рүү гүйдэг болно.
sentences.en: If a puppy gets too attached to people, it will start leaving the flock and running to the ger.
alt_en: If you get a puppy too used to people, it will start abandoning the flock and running back to the ger.
sentences.mn_latin: Gölgiig khünd khet ikh dasgaval sürgee orkhij, ger rüü güideg bolno.

sentences.mn: Үржүүлгийн хөтөлбөрийн ажилтан малчидтайгаа сар бүр уулздаг.
sentences.en: The breeding-program officer meets with her herders every month.
alt_en: The breeding-program officer meets her herders once a month.
sentences.mn_latin: Ürjüülgiin khötölböriin ajiltan malchidtaigaa sar bür uulzdag.

sentences.mn: Хурга ишиг гөлгөөс айхаа болимогц тэд хамтдаа хэвтэж эхэлдэг.
sentences.en: As soon as the lambs and kids stop being afraid of the puppy, they start lying down together.
alt_en: Once the lambs and kids stop fearing the puppy, they start lying down together.
sentences.mn_latin: Khurga ishig gölgöös aikhaa bolimogts ted khamtdaa khevtej ekheldeg.

sentences.mn: Гөлөг ээжтэйгээ хоёр сар байсны дараа сүрэгт шилждэг.
sentences.en: A puppy stays with its mother for two months and then moves to the flock.
alt_en: After two months with its mother, a puppy moves in with the flock.
sentences.mn_latin: Gölög eejteigee khoyor sar baisny daraa süregt shiljdeg.

sentences.mn: Нохой эзэндээ итгэж эхэлмэгц тушаалыг нь сонсдог болдог.
sentences.en: As soon as a dog begins to trust its owner, it starts listening to commands.
alt_en: Once a dog starts trusting its owner, it begins to obey commands.
sentences.mn_latin: Nokhoi ezendee itgej ekhelmegts tushaalyg ni sonsdog boldog.

grammar.title_en: Comitative + reflexive: -тайгаа/-тэйгээ/-тойгоо; 'no sooner had... than' vs. 'as soon as'
grammar.title_mn: Хамтрах тийн ялгал + өөрийн хамаатуулах нөхцөл; 'no sooner had... than' ба 'as soon as'
grammar.explain_en: The comitative case -тай/-тэй/-той means 'with': сүрэгтэй means 'with a flock'. Add the reflexive possessive -аа/-ээ/-оо and you get 'with one's own': сүрэгтэйгээ means 'with its own flock'. The ending follows vowel harmony. Words with а, у take -тайгаа (хургатайгаа). Words with э, ү, и take -тэйгээ (эзэнтэйгээ, сүрэгтэйгээ). Words with о take -тойгоо (нохойтойгоо). Words with ө take -тэйгөө (гөлөгтэйгөө). Use it when the companion belongs to the subject of the sentence. In 'Нохой эзэнтэйгээ явлаа', the dog goes with its own owner. Bonus: the verb ending -магц/-мэгц/-могц means 'as soon as' (ирмэгц, болимогц).
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд хоёр үйл явдал бараг зэрэг болсныг 'as soon as' болон 'no sooner had... than' гэж илэрхийлнэ. 'As soon as' нь энгийн, бүх цагт хэрэглэнэ. Жишээ нь: As soon as the wolf came, the dog barked. 'No sooner' нь илүү уран, бичгийн хэллэг бөгөөд ихэвчлэн өнгөрсөн цагт хэрэглэнэ. Бүтэц нь: No sooner + had + үйлдэгч + V3 + than + өгүүлбэр. Туслах үйл үг 'had' үйлдэгчийн өмнө гарч, үгийн дараалал урвуу болдгийг анхаараарай: 'No sooner had the wolf come...', харин 'No sooner the wolf had' гэж болохгүй. Мөн 'than'-ыг 'when' эсвэл 'then'-ээр сольж болохгүй. Монгол хэлний -магц/-мэгц нөхцөл энэ хоёрын аль алинд нь тохирно.

examples.en: The puppy grows up with its flock.
The ewe is grazing with her lamb.
The bankhar is lying in the pen with her puppy.
No sooner had the herder whistled than the dog came back.

fill_blank.translation: The dog went out to pasture with its owner.
fill_blank.explain_en: эзэн has front vowels (э), so the comitative-reflexive ending is -тэйгээ. It means 'with its own owner'.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Эзэн' эм үгийн эгшигтэй тул -тэйгээ залгана. Өөрийн эзэнтэй хамт гэсэн утгатай.

fill_blank.translation: The ewe is grazing with her lamb.
fill_blank.explain_en: хурга has back vowels (у, а), so it takes -тайгаа. The lamb belongs to the subject, the ewe.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Хурга' эр үгийн эгшигтэй тул -тайгаа залгана. Хурга нь өгүүлэгдэхүүн болох хонины өөрийнх юм.

fill_blank.translation: As soon as the wolf appeared, the dog started barking.
fill_blank.explain_en: -магц means 'as soon as'. харагдах has back vowels, so the form is -магц, not -мэгц.
fill_blank.explain_mn: -магц нөхцөл 'тэр даруй, мөдхөн' гэсэн утгатай. 'Харагдах' эр үг тул -магц залгана.

fill_blank.text: No sooner ___ the puppy arrived than it ran to the lambs.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'No sooner' is followed by inversion with the past perfect: had + subject + past participle.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'No sooner'-ын дараа урвуу дараалал орно: had + үйлдэгч + V3. 'Arrived' нь V3 хэлбэр тул 'had' хэрэгтэй.

fill_blank.text: No sooner had the wolf appeared ___ the dogs started barking.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'No sooner' always pairs with 'than', because it is a comparative form of 'soon'.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'No sooner' нь 'soon' үгийн харьцуулах хэлбэр тул заавал 'than'-тай хамт хэрэглэнэ. 'When' эсвэл 'then' гэвэл алдаа болно.

fill_blank.text: ___ the herder whistled, the dog came back.
fill_blank.explain_en: The rest of the sentence has normal word order and no 'than', so only 'As soon as' fits. 'No sooner' would need 'had' and 'than'.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Өгүүлбэр энгийн дараалалтай, 'than' байхгүй тул зөвхөн 'As soon as' тохирно. 'No sooner' бол урвуу дараалал болон 'than' шаарддаг.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Гөлгийг малчинд хэдэн насанд нь хүлээлгэн өгдөг вэ?
dialogue.en: At what age do you hand a puppy over to a herder?
dialogue.mn_latin: Gölgiig malchind kheden nasand ni khüleelgen ögdög ve?

dialogue.speaker: Сарангэрэл
dialogue.mn: Ихэвчлэн найман долоо хоногтойд нь. Тэр болтол гөлөг ээжтэйгээ байдаг.
dialogue.en: Usually at eight weeks. Until then, the puppy stays with its mother.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ikhevchlen naiman doloo khonogtoid ni. Ter boltol gölög eejteigee baidag.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: And then you put it straight in with the flock?

dialogue.speaker: Сарангэрэл
dialogue.mn: Тийм. Хурга ишигтэй хамт өсгөдөг. Хашаанд орж ирмэгц л хургануудыг үнэрлэж эхэлдэг.
dialogue.en: Yes, we raise it with the lambs and kids. As soon as it enters the pen, it starts sniffing the lambs.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim. Khurga ishigtei khamt ösgödög. Khashaand orj irmegts l khurganuudyg ünerlej ekheldeg.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Can the children play with the puppy?

dialogue.speaker: Сарангэрэл
dialogue.mn: Бага зэрэг болно. Хүнд хэт дасгавал сүрэгтэйгээ биш, хүмүүстэй байхыг хүсдэг болчихдог.
dialogue.en: A little. If it gets too used to people, it will want to be with people instead of its flock.
dialogue.mn_latin: Baga zereg bolno. Khünd khet dasgaval süregteigee bish, khümüüstei baikhyg khüsdeg bolchikhdog.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Тэгвэл итгэл яаж бий болдог вэ?
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegvel itgel yaaj bii boldog ve?

dialogue.speaker: Сарангэрэл
dialogue.mn: Өдөр бүр эзэнтэйгээ хамт малаа хариулж байж бий болдог.
dialogue.en: It develops by herding the livestock with its owner every day.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ödör bür ezenteigee khamt malaa khariulj baij bii boldog.

culture_note.en: Since the 2010s, a breeding program in Mongolia has revived the traditional bankhar dog and placed puppies with herding families free of charge. The aim is to protect livestock from wolves without killing them. Puppies are raised right in the sheep and goat pen, so they bond with the animals and treat the flock as their own family.
culture_note.mn: 2010-аад оноос хойш Монголд банхар нохойг сэргээх үржүүлгийн хөтөлбөр хэрэгжиж, гөлгийг малчин айлуудад үнэгүй өгч байна. Энэ нь чоно агнахгүйгээр малыг хамгаалах зорилготой. Гөлгийг хонь ямааны хашаанд шууд өсгөдөг тул тэд малд дасаж, сүргээ өөрийн гэр бүл шиг хайрладаг.

review.notes: Solid lesson with correct Mongolian forms and accurate pairs. The main real issue was an ambiguous English fill-in-the-blank option.

opus_fix.notes: Mostly solid. Fixed a missing case ending, a grammar term, an unnatural 'no sooner' line in the dialogue, and a causative mismatch in a vocab example.

changes.why: 'бэлчээр явлаа' lacks a case ending; standard form is 'бэлчээрт гарлаа'
the standard term is 'хамтрах тийн ялгал'
'No sooner has... than' with a habitual present is unnatural
the Mongolian is causative (дасгах), not 'get used to'
